description: GET /api/v1/solar-forecast — 7-day estimated kWh from a home/small-business solar array (US ZIP + capacityW, 10000=10 kW). Weather-based production only; pair with calculate_profitability or list_miners for miner profit.

capacityW.description: Solar array capacity in Watts (10000 = 10 kW). Falls back to the API-key owner profile solarW.

zipCode.description: 5-digit US ZIP code. Falls back to the API-key owner profile, then a server default.

name: get_solar_forecast
title: Get solar forecast
